# stash
mixed-port: 7890
allow-lan: false
mode: rule
log-level: info

proxies:
  - name: "golden-node"
    type: vless
    server: "203.0.113.10"
    port: 443
    uuid: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
    udp: true
    tls: true
    servername: "example.com"
    network: ws
    ws-opts:
      path: "/ws"
      headers:
        Host: "cdn.example.com"

proxy-groups:
  - name: "PROXY"
    type: select
    proxies:
      - "AUTO"
      - "其他"
      - "DIRECT"
  - name: "AUTO"
    type: url-test
    url: "http://www.gstatic.com/generate_204"
    interval: 300
    tolerance: 50
    proxies:
      - "golden-node"
  - name: "其他"
    type: url-test
    url: "http://www.gstatic.com/generate_204"
    interval: 300
    tolerance: 50
    proxies:
      - "golden-node"

rules:
  - "MATCH,PROXY"
